title: Dermot O'Leary
description: Hot off their 8th Number 1 album, Kasabian frontman Serge Pizzorno joins Dermot. Plus, History Hit's Dan Snow dials in from his latest Shackleton-inspired adventure.

title: Romesh Ranganathan
description: Actor Bill Hader (Superbad, Inside Out) joins Romesh live in the studio to chat about the new The Cat In the Hat movie.

title: Ellie Taylor
description: Spend Saturday lunchtime with Ellie. Whether you're out and about or chilling at home, Ellie is standing by to speak to you and hit shuffle on all your favourite music.

title: Rylan on Saturday
description: Comedy legend Ruby Wax joins Rylan to spill the beans on her brand new tour, Absolutely Famous, coming next year, and reveals her favourite films and TV shows for the RY Player.

title: Sounds of the 80s with Gary Davies
description: A weekly celebration of the greatest musical decade - 'If you were there, you'd know'... and if you weren't, pay attention.

title: Sounds of the 90s with Fearne Cotton
description: David Baddiel looks back at his 90s, from topping the charts with Three Lions, to selling out Wembley Arena to becoming the first 'rock star of comedy'.

title: Dance Sounds of the 90s with Vernon Kay
description: Get your custom 90s horoscope as Vernon selects songs to match every sign of the Zodiac.

title: Alternative Sounds of the 90s with Dermot O'Leary
description: Dermot has a Britpop Weekender with Shed 7, Rialto, Suede, Sleeper, Oasis, Elastica & Lush.

title: CMA Music Festival 2026
description: 2/5. Country star Shelly Fairchild with live music and interviews from the CMA Music Festival 2026 in Nashville featuring Keith Urban, Cody Johnson, The Band Perry and Shaboozey.

title: Tony Blackburn's Sounds of Soul
description: Tony's back with more heartwarming soul music and gems from across the decades. Including new music from Bruno Mars and the Sunburst Band, plus classics from Diana Ross and more.

title: Romesh Ranganathan: For the Love of Hip-Hop
description: To celebrate the winter holidays, Romesh welcomes some of his guests back onto the show to play some festive hip-hop. There are tunes from Outkast, Smino and Sweet Tea.

title: Dolly Parton's Good List
description: Another chance to hear global music icon Dolly Parton talk to Claudia Winkleman about her life, career and loves, as seen through her memories of Christmas.

title: Mariah Carey's Christmas Hour
description: Mariah's personally curated playlist which includes Christmas classics old and new from the artists who have inspired her.

title: Tracks of My Years
description: Gary Barlow, Howard Donald and Mark Owen from Take That join Vernon Kay to choose ten songs from their lives.

title: Good Morning Sunday
description: The Reverend Kate Bottley and Jason Mohammad are joined by Scottish poet Donna Ashworth for her Reflections.

title: Love Songs with Michael Ball
description: Your true stories and favourite love songs with Michael... easy like Sunday morning.

title: Paddy McGuinness
description: Paddy's live from Salford every Sunday morning with The Weekest Link quiz, the Kitchen Tip-Line, Paddy's Timewarp and another BIG question.

title: Elaine Paige on Sunday
description: Dame Elaine is celebrating Guys and Dolls and the Wicked films. Plus your Pantomime Break A Leg messages, Pick of the Flicks and her Winter Warmer Double Bill.

title: Sounds of the 70s with Shaun Keaveny
description: Ocean Colour Scene frontman Simon Fowler reveals his essential 'My 70s' tracks.

title: Pick of the Pops
description: Mark Goodier counts down the chart from this day in 1981.

title: Pick of the Pops
description: Mark Goodier counts down the chart from this day in 1995.

title: Tony Blackburn's Golden Hour
description: Tony Blackburn spins his personal pick of the hits from across the decades. To listen on most smart speakers just 'ask BBC Sounds to play Tony Blackburn's Golden Hour'.

title: CMA Awards 2026
description: Darius Rucker with the 60th annual Country Music Association Awards, country's biggest night. With Ella Langley, Taylor Swift, Chris Stapleton and Brooks & Dunn among many others.

title: Radio 2 Unwinds with Angela Griffin
description: Angela Griffin marks Thanksgiving season with a nod to gratitude, and reasons to be thankful.

title: Radio 2 Unwinds Mix with Angela Griffin
description: Your soundtrack to a peaceful rest, featuring Sade, Stevie Wonder, Lionel Richie and more.

title: Richie Anderson
description: Richie Anderson is live from Salford with your Monday Motivation to kick-start a brand new week, plus Secret Star and This Week in Songs.
